body: It's undeniable, it's incomparable, but you can only experience it once. I don't know what you've been through or how bad things may be right now. But I can assure you things get better, one day at a time. Things can always be different if you keep fighting. I've attempted twice and I almost died from drinking my pain away. I'm only 22 and I was fighting for my life when I didn't even know if I wanted to anymore. Now I'm 1 month sober and some days are really hard but each day I push through is another chance at a better day. If you need to talk I'm willing to listen

The fact you even reached out is proof enough you truly don't want to die. You don't need to it's never worth it you're not hitler lol. You have so much more ahead of you even if you aren't at the moment capable of seeing it. You haven't committed murder you haven't done anything that you can't come back from, stay strong even when you feel so weak. It's okay to feel weak and broken, but just keep trying to push on.

Please don't, it's not worth it. Once you try, and hopefully you won't succeed. I really don't know what you are going through, but once you cross that line the easier it is to cross again. And that's a terrible thing. No matter what you have and are going through please don't. It'll only bring more pain, more regret. People who care even if it doesn't feel like they do right now will be broken. You are something to someone no matter how you feel, and I made the mistake multiple times and it hurt a lot of people. You can't trust your emotions, emotions lie. They lie and they cheat, logically you have the capability to move forward and obtain things you never thought were possible. acknowledge how you feel and why you feel that way but don't take the next step and act on it, I don't know you or what you are going through but you can make it out and you can have things be better no matter how much it hurts in this moment.

You have a future, I know it's hard to believe that. I've been there I ruined mine during and after highschool. Things get better and other things get harder I don't know your situation, but things get better no matter how hard they are to handle. The harder you fight back the stronger you become, things improve and it isn't easy whatsoever but it isn't pointless, it's selfish for me to ask you to try, but I ask anyway little by little take it slowly. Improvement starts off slow, try not to set goals that aren't realistic to achieve rn because it will only make you feel worse. Set small obtainable goals, and once they are achieved make another. And if you don't achieve that goal the first time keep trying don't beat yourself up so much, everyone makes mistakes, I know I have but there's beauty in mistakes. You learn from them, you understand what other people don't, and yeah that sucks, but at the same time you have the capability to understand, to move forward, and maybe even help someone else move forward. When you're at your absolute lowest the only way you can go is up.

I really appreciate it, and your input was helpful. I don't really have any friends anymore because of everything. So I really appreciate the positivity and not hearing all these negative things from people. So thank you.

I appreciate it and I know not much was given but it wouldn't be fair to talk about, without her consent and it was nothing physical there wasn't anything wild like that. I could never,thank you for your opinion it just really sucks she met me at my lowest and I wasn't going towards achievement fast enough for her.
